title: Industrial AI Quality Inspection Based on IndustryGPT Multimodal Industrial Large Model
summary: SmartMore reports that, in one classification test, the training that IndustryGPT chose reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: SmartMore released IndustryGPT in 2023, according to the company's Hong Kong listing document. In its submission to the ITU AI for Good report of 2025, SmartMore reports that an IndustryGPT model-training example reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training. Recall was 100% with IndustryGPT and 66.7% with manual training. The submission also describes commercial production-line applications, but customer financial returns remain unmeasured. SmartMore's Hong Kong listing document, filed on 16 March 2026, says that the company had served over 730 customers and had delivered about 140,000 industrial AI agents built on IndustryGPT by 31 December 2025. These are company figures for all its products. The same document claims that ViMo annotation runs more than eight times faster than manual labeling. No published independent test of the model is known.
purpose: Simplify industrial inspection-model development and improve defect detection.

ratings.reason: In SmartMore’s model-training example, IndustryGPT achieved 100% accuracy and recall, compared with 50% accuracy and 66.7% recall for manual training, alongside shorter training time. Production revenue remains unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: IndustryGPT converts natural-language requests into model-development steps on the ViMo platform, including annotation, tuning, and training. The quoted result is a technical comparison.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Industrial AI Quality Inspection Based on IndustryGPT Multimodal Industrial Large Model
evidence.quote: In a specific classification detection example, the solution chosen by IndustryGPT achieved remarkable results: it took only 5 minutes and 27 seconds with 100% accuracy and recall rates.

evidence.citation: SmartMore Inc., Application Proof filed with The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, March 2026. The company wrote this draft listing document; the exchange and the Securities and Futures Commission take no responsibility for its contents, and it reports company-wide figures without isolating the classification example.
evidence.title: Application Proof of SmartMore Inc.
evidence.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had delivered approximately 140,000 industrial AI agents, and our robots had cumulatively inspected over 17 billion products and components.

evidence.citation: SmartMore, 独角兽思谋科技携全球首个工业多模态大模型亮相进博会 (Unicorn SmartMore brings the world's first industrial multimodal large model to the China International Import Expo), Leiphone, 5 November 2023. Leiphone ran the text under the byline nebula, and most of it recurs, much of it word for word, in SmartMore's own WeChat post of 7 November 2023, so the text is the company's announcement that its founder Jia Jiaya launched IndustryGPT V1.0 that day at the Hongqiao International Economic Forum of the sixth China International Import Expo, with the classification result from the company's demonstration.
evidence.title: 独角兽思谋科技携全球首个工业多模态大模型亮相进博会
evidence.quote: 例如以思谋自研的工业智能通用型平台SMore ViMo为例，在一项产品分类检测中，IndustryGPT选择的方案耗时5分钟27秒，且精确率和召回率均达100%，而人工训练下方案耗时长达9分钟31秒，精确率仅50%、召回率66.7%。
